✨ How It Works

Rent or list in minutes

Our simple 3-step process gets you from zero to published in under 5 minutes.

📋 How to get a referral code
  1. Log in to your Rent Nivas account on any device.
  2. Look at the left sidebar — just below your email address you will see your personal Ref. Code displayed (e.g. RC: 12345678).
  3. Click the code to instantly copy it to your clipboard.
  4. Share that 8-digit code with people you refer to the platform.
  5. When they create a new listing, they paste your code in this field to acknowledge you as the referrer.

⚙️ Platform Settings

Control how credits flow between renters and owners.

🔓 Unlock Owner Reward Rate

When Person B unlocks Person A's listing using 1 credit, how many credits does Person A (the owner) receive?
Default is 1. Set to 0.8 means platform keeps 0.2, owner gets 0.8.

Examples:
1 → owner gets 1 full credit per unlock
0.8 → owner gets 0.8 credits per unlock
0 → owner gets nothing (platform keeps all)

Frequently asked questions
What is the Refer and Earn program? ▾
Refer & Earn lets you share your unique referral code with others. When someone signs up or adds a listing using your code, you earn 0.50 credits automatically — plus +5 XP since you're a Partner.
When do I get my reward? ▾
Your credits are added as soon as the referred person completes a valid signup or listing. Check the history section above to track all your rewards.
Is there a limit on referrals? ▾
No limit — you can refer as many people as you want and earn credits for each one!
Does my friend get anything? ▾
The referral reward goes to you (the referrer). Your friend gets access to the platform but no extra credits for using your code.
